Add validation helpers in openbrain-memory for the live Open Brain contract. get_contract is the live source of truth; package constants are snapshots only and must not be treated as authoritative when live contract data is available.

Scope:
- Validate contract_scope values returned by get_contract.
- Validate required tools are present for supported client flows.
- Validate compatible client ranges before runtime use.
- Validate transport/auth assumptions needed by package callers.
- Keep package constants as documented snapshots, with drift checks against live get_contract.
- Add tests covering valid, missing, and incompatible contract responses.
